exposure: small for gestational age at birth
access to public health services (no-primary care)
cohort: The study participants were 14,159 children under 5 years of age from the Brazilian National Survey on Child Nutrition.
finding: Adverse health, nutrition, and learning factors, including emergency C-section and consumption of ultra-processed food, were inversely associated with a lower Developmental Quotient in Brazilian children, highlighting an inequitable environment for Early Childhood Development.
mod_finding: For children aged 1-35 months, emergency C-section was inversely associated with a lower Developmental Quotient.
cross-section timing: Data from the Brazilian National Survey on Child Nutrition (ENANI 2019-2025)
